name: PearlNet
description: Is a dynamic social media application built with Next.js, designed to connect users through seamless content sharing and real-time interaction. It features a modern, responsive interface where users can customize their profiles, post updates, interact with content, and follow feeds. The platform prioritizes speed, performance, and user engagement, delivering a fluid social experience across all devices

name: backend-project
description: A backend‑focused school project using JavaScript, SQL, Node.js, and Express. It demonstrates database integration, API design, and server‑side logic for managing structured data. It provides a solid foundation for backend development and is a valuable learning experience for developers.

name: Handcrafted Haven Team
description: A collaborative school project built with Next.js and Tailwind CSS. It showcases a handcrafted marketplace concept, focusing on clean UI, responsive design, and modern frontend practices.

name: XP-streams
description: A streaming platform prototype designed for entertainment content. It emphasizes smooth navigation, media playback, and a user‑friendly interface for discovering and enjoying streams.

name: forever-quotes
description: A quotes application that curates inspirational and motivational sayings. Built for simplicity and readability, it allows users to browse and reflect on timeless wisdom.

name: wdd330-sleepoutside
description: A school project built with Vite, simulating an e‑commerce storefront for outdoor gear. It highlights product listings, shopping cart functionality, and responsive layouts.

name: c# pr0jects
description: A collection of C# programming exercises and projects, showcasing problem‑solving, object‑oriented design, and practical coding skills.

name: ecotourism
description: A static site built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript promoting eco‑friendly tourism. It emphasizes sustainability, nature appreciation, and clean web design.

name: Water Rafting site
